title: Randomized Parallel Complexity of Weakly Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.07675v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the minimum number of query rounds needed to find approximate stationary points of nonsmooth weakly convex functions, measured by the gradient of the Moreau envelope. Each round permits multiple simultaneous queries. In the stated parameter regime, the standard subgradient rate is optimal in sufficiently high dimensions, even for randomized algorithms making polynomially many parallel queries per round. We then show how the order structure of the real line enables faster search: a deterministic algorithm using only function values achieves logarithmic round complexity, with a further reduction through parallel queries. Matching lower bounds hold even when each query returns the entire subdifferential. Together, these results clarify the role of dimension in determining the benefits of parallel queries for weakly convex optimization.

translated_title: 弱凸优化的随机并行复杂性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了寻找非光滑弱凸函数近似驻点所需的最小查询轮数，该复杂性以Moreau包络的梯度来度量，其中每一轮允许进行多个同时查询。在所述参数范围内，标准次梯度速率在足够高的维度中是最优的，即使对于每轮进行多项式数量并行查询的随机算法也是如此。随后，我们展示了实数的序结构如何实现更快的搜索：一个仅使用函数值的确定性算法即可达到对数轮复杂度，且通过并行查询可进一步降低复杂度。即使每次查询返回完整的次微分集合，匹配的下界依然成立。这些结果共同阐明了维度在决定弱凸优化中并行查询收益方面所起的作用。
tldr: 本文证明了在高维空间中即使随机算法每轮进行多项式数量的并行查询也无法超越标准次梯度方法的速率，但在一维情形下利用实数的序结构，仅用函数值的确定性算法即可实现对数轮复杂度，从而揭示了维度对并行查询收益的决定性作用。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in sufficiently high dimensions the standard subgradient rate remains optimal even for randomized algorithms making polynomially many parallel queries per round, while in one dimension the order structure of the real line enables logarithmic round complexity with deterministic algorithms using only function values, clarifying the role of dimension in determining the benefits of parallel queries for weakly convex optimization.
